cursor.name: bcms
cursor.installMethod: Add this repository as a Cursor plugin marketplace (manifest at .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json), then install the "bcms" plugin.

claude-code.name: bcms
claude-code.installMethod: claude plugin marketplace add bcms/ai, then claude plugin install bcms.

cli.name: bcms-content-cli
cli.installMethod: npx skills add bcms/ai --skill bcms-content, then npm install inside the installed skill folder. Not published to npm.

mcp.authentication: mcpKey query parameter — a three-part BCMS MCP key (keyId.secret.instanceId). MCP keys are per-project and not scoped (full access to entries, templates, groups, widgets, and media). Do not call this an API key. Send the mcp-session-id header on follow-up requests after initialize.

clientNotes.cursor: Add a url entry to mcp.json (see providers/cursor/plugin/mcp.json.example).
clientNotes.other: Any client that supports Streamable HTTP MCP servers can connect with the endpoint template above.

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.notes: Plugin bundle in providers/cursor/plugin with a marketplace manifest in this repository; not listed in the public Cursor marketplace directory. Skills also install via skills.sh.

claude-code.name: Claude Code
claude-code.notes: Plugin bundle in providers/claude/plugin installable via claude plugin marketplace add bcms/ai; not listed in a public Claude marketplace directory. Skills also install via skills.sh.

codex.name: Codex
codex.notes: No dedicated package. Skills install via the skills.sh CLI into agent skill folders that Codex reads; MCP connects over Streamable HTTP. Not tested by maintainers.

chatgpt.name: ChatGPT
chatgpt.notes: No package, connector, or documented install path.

openclaw.name: OpenClaw
openclaw.notes: Both skills are published on ClawHub and install with openclaw skills install @bcms/<skill>.

clawhub.name: ClawHub (registry)
clawhub.notes: Registry listing for OpenClaw installs: https://clawhub.ai/bcms/bcms and https://clawhub.ai/bcms/bcms-content.

skills.sh.name: skills.sh (registry)
skills.sh.notes: Registry listing: https://www.skills.sh/bcms/ai/bcms and https://www.skills.sh/bcms/ai/bcms-content. Installs run from this GitHub repository.
